formal_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (I : Fin N → Fin N → Prop) [DecidableRel I] (Ckt : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), (∀ p p' l l' : Fin N, p ≠ p' → l ≠ l' → ¬ (I p l ∧ I p l' ∧ I p' l ∧ I p' l')) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 Ckt → PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.HasLineDegree (N + N) (Finset.Ico N (N + N)) Ckt 3 → (∀ z : Fin (N + N) → Bool, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (N + N) Ckt z = true ↔ ∃ p l : Fin N, I p l ∧ z (Fin.castAdd N p) = true ∧ z (Fin.natAdd N l) = true) → (Finset.univ.filter (fun e : Fin N × Fin N => I e.1 e.2)).card ≤ 888 * Ckt.size + 9 * N + 444
plain_statement: On N points and N lines with no two points on two common lines (inputs: the points, then the lines; line-degree: line 1, point 0, AND the sum, OR the maximum), every AND/OR circuit of fan-in at most two and output line-degree at most 3 that computes the incidence function has at most 888 times its size plus 9N plus 444 incidences. No hypotheses. Conjecture, on paper: the checked conditional form applied to four checked statements.
title: Line-degree 3, unconditional: every AND/OR circuit of line-degree at most 3 computing the incidence function has at most 888 size + 9N + 444 incidences
